# Fusion Mushroom Bars EU
> European store for hand-finished Belgian chocolate bars, fruit pectin gummies, and curator boxes.

Google Search does not use this file. It is a plain-text index for other agents.

Fusion Mushroom Bars EU sells confectionery. Product pages are the published description for each item. The shop does not give medical advice, and a bar is not a treatment.

- https://fusionbars.eu/en : Homepage
- https://fusionbars.eu/en/shop : Catalogue
- https://fusionbars.eu/en/about : How the bars are made and where parcels leave
- https://fusionbars.eu/en/faq : Ordering, payment, and dispatch
- https://fusionbars.eu/en/shipping : Shipping, delivery, and returns
- https://fusionbars.eu/en/refunds : Refunds, returns, and exchanges
- https://fusionbars.eu/en/contact : European support desk
- https://fusionbars.eu/en/news : Store notes
- https://fusionbars.eu/en/glossary : Words this shop uses
- https://fusionbars.eu/en/compare : Bar, gummy, and curator box
- https://fusionbars.eu/en/figures : Prices and thresholds published on the store

- https://fusionbars.eu/en/privacy : Privacy notice

## Catalogue
Product URLs use https://fusionbars.eu/en/products/{slug}. English is the indexable language. Other locale URLs canonicalise to the English page.

## Commercial facts published on the store
- Currency display is euro, with a pound display option.
- A single Fusion chocolate bar is €20, or £17.50 when pounds are shown. The 10-bar tasting box is €150, or £128 in pounds.
- Buying questions for European countries — how to buy, where to buy, and what a bar costs in the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, Germany, Italy, France, Spain, and neighbouring countries — are answered on the homepage, FAQ, shipping page, about page, and news notes.
- Bank transfer is offered from €100, or £100 when prices are shown in pounds.
- Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Bitcoin Cash take 10% off the merchandise subtotal. Shipping is not discounted.
- Standard shipping is free once merchandise reaches €300, or £260 in pounds.
- Parcels leave from hubs in the Netherlands, Spain, Germany, and France.
- Support: sales@fusionbars.eu
- Store address: Avinguda Alcora 412, 12006 Castelló de la Plana, Castelló, Spain
- UK branch office: 519 Beverley Dr, Stoke-on-Trent ST2 0QB, UK
- Shop notes are written by the shop desk. No named author or social profile is on file.
- The glossary links Wikipedia and Wikidata for chocolate, couverture chocolate, cocoa butter, and ISO/IEC 17025. The brand has no Wikidata item.
- No Google Business Profile URL is on file. Map links only search the printed addresses.
